title: Cowboy on Mechanical Bull
description: A silhouetted cowboy in a hat and fringed jacket rides a large, armored black bull-like mechanical creature through a dark cosmic void. The scene is filled with floating mechanical bull skulls, gears, swirling purple nebulae, and fragmented debris against a deep space background.
prompt: A lone cowboy wearing a wide-brimmed hat and dark fringed jacket rides a massive armored mechanical bull with glowing details through a surreal cosmic landscape. Floating around them are mechanical bull skulls, gears, and broken debris. Swirling purple and blue nebulae mix with dark space and red energy streaks in a dramatic, cinematic composition with strong silhouettes and atmospheric depth.
